div.div:
PUT replaces every editable field of the stored entity; fields absent from the request body are written as null/0, not preserved (the id is kept). DELETE removes the row but performs no cascade — interactions referencing the customer are not removed.
Role enforcement happens in Spring Security before the controller runs: unauthenticated → 401, authenticated non-ADMIN → 403. A structurally invalid body → 400 with joined field errors (handler extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler).
